intro.h2: Wood and stone, planned and installed by one team
paragraphs: Continental Wood and Stone Company supplies and installs kitchen cabinets in Defiance, along with the countertops that go on top of them. Because cabinets and stone come from the same team, there is one schedule and one set of people to call. Google reviewers mention installation more than anything else.

Customers come back. One homeowner has had them complete four kitchen renovations plus several custom wood projects. A local contractor had them install countertops in his own house and now uses them as his exclusive installer. Another customer's cabinets arrived quickly and went in in a single day, with every cabinet set perfectly.

items.name: Kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: Kitchen cabinets in painted white, deep espresso and natural wood, laid out with you and installed by the team. Reviewers say the cabinets arrive quickly, look beautiful, and are installed with every single box set just right.

image.alt: White shaker kitchen cabinets installed around a vaulted room with an island base, ready for countertops

items.name: Countertop installation
items.blurb: Quartz and granite countertops installed on kitchen runs and islands, from thick white quartz island tops to dark speckled granite. A local contractor who now uses them for all of his jobs calls their installations flawless.

image.alt: Kitchen island with dark granite countertop and white cabinets, bar stools and glass-front upper cabinets with wine rack

items.name: Bathroom vanities
items.blurb: Vanity cabinets and tops for bathrooms, from a simple white top in a powder room to a granite-topped vanity with tall built-in storage. Bathroom remodeling is listed among the services on the shop's Facebook page, alongside kitchens and flooring.

items.name: Custom woodworking
items.blurb: Custom wood projects beyond the kitchen, such as natural wood cabinetry and built-ins. A long-time customer uses the team for all of her custom kitchen and woodworking needs, and says they keep the work area immaculate through the whole project.

about.text: Continental Wood and Stone Company is a kitchen supply and installation shop at 919 Grove St in Defiance, Ohio. As the name says, the work is wood and stone: cabinets, countertops, vanities and custom woodwork. Customers name Nathan and Lindsey, and describe the team as responsive, professional and kind from planning to install. Their customers range from homeowners doing one kitchen to a homeowner on her fourth kitchen with them, plus local contractors who hand them their installs. Stop by Grove St during open hours to talk through your plans.

image.alt: White kitchen with gray granite island, bar stools, crystal pendant lights and stainless French door refrigerator

steps.title: Call or stop in
steps.text: Call (419) 789-9765 or visit 919 Grove St during open hours to talk about your kitchen or bath.

steps.title: Plan the layout
steps.text: Work through cabinet styles, layout and countertop choices with Nathan and the team, who often suggest ideas homeowners had not considered.

steps.title: Cabinets arrive
steps.text: Your cabinets are ordered and delivered. Reviewers say they arrived quickly and looked beautiful out of the box.

steps.title: Install cabinets and tops
steps.text: The team installs the cabinets and then the countertops. One customer's full cabinet installation was finished in a single day.

steps.title: Clean finish
steps.text: The work area is left clean and every cabinet is checked, so you can start using your new kitchen.

items.name: Amy P.
items.text:
Nathan, Lindsey, and the team made my dream kitchen come true! From planning to install they were very responsive, professional, and kind.
The cabinets arrived quickly and are absolutely beautiful.
They did the installation in one day and every single cabinet is perfect.
Honestly, I would choose this company over and over again.

items.name: Lee G.
items.text: Nathan and his team at Continental Wood and Stone do phenomenal work. Not only are their installations flawless but Nathan has great ideas and suggestions that the average homeowner might not think about. I have had them install countertops in my own house and now that I’m a contractor they are my exclusive installer.

items.name: Carley R.
items.text:
I've had the pleasure of working with Continental Wood and Stone on multiple occasions, and their consistent excellence has made them my go-to for all custom kitchen, and woodworking needs. Their exceptional craftsmanship is evident in the four kitchen renovations they've completed for me, along with various custom wood projects.

What truly sets this team apart is their rare combination of quality, efficiency, and attention to detail. Each project is executed with meticulous precision, and they maintain immaculate work areas throughout the process. Beyond their technical expertise, they bring a refreshing personality to the job site that makes the renovation experience genuinely enjoyable.

For anyone considering kitchen renovations or custom woodworking, I cannot recommend Continental Wood and Stone highly enough. Their unparalleled skill and professional approach have exceeded my expectations with every project.

service_area.text: Continental Wood and Stone Company works from 919 Grove St in Defiance, Ohio, and Defiance is the town named on its Google and Facebook pages. If you are planning new cabinets, countertops or a vanity in or around Defiance, call (419) 789-9765 to check that your home is in their install area and to set up a time to talk it through.

items.q: Do you do both cabinets and countertops?
items.a: Yes. The team supplies and installs kitchen cabinets and installs countertops, and the photos show white quartz, gray granite and dark granite tops on their cabinets. Having both from one company means one schedule and one team to call if anything needs attention.

It depends on the size of the kitchen, so ask when you plan your project. One Google reviewer said her cabinets arrived quickly and the team did the full cabinet installation in one day, with every single cabinet set perfectly. Countertops follow once the cabinets are in.

Yes. A local contractor says on Google that after they installed countertops in his own house, Continental Wood and Stone became his exclusive installer. Builders and remodelers can call (419) 789-9765 to talk about scheduling and their upcoming kitchen and bath jobs.

Monday and Friday 9 AM to 6 PM, Tuesday and Thursday 9 AM to 2 PM. The shop is closed Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday. You can also email woodandstonecompany@gmail.com any day with photos or rough measurements of your space and the team will reply.

items.q: Can you help if something breaks later?
items.a: Ask. Google's review summary quotes a customer whose sink cracked: the team ordered and replaced it very quickly. Call with a photo of the problem and a description, and they can tell you what they can do and how soon.

final_cta.text: Call Nathan and the team to talk cabinets and countertops.
